goals.goal: Hold aggregate spending inside the statutory ceiling
Avoid being blamed for a programme failure

fears: Losing the ceiling as a credible constraint on other programmes

factions.name: Budget directorate
factions.veto_scope: any new commitment above the ceiling

decision_rule: The budget directorate prevails unless the ceiling itself is raised by legislation, in which case the liaison unit's preference carries.

constraints.constraint: Cannot approve a commitment above the ceiling
Cannot be seen to block infrastructure without a fiscal reason

options.action: Withhold co-signature until the cost estimate is revised
Request a legislative increase to the ceiling

ruled_out.reason: Would destroy the constraint it exists to defend

reaction_function.if: The sponsoring body submits a revised estimate inside the ceiling
reaction_function.then: Co-signature is granted without further delay
reaction_function.because: The veto is fiscal, not substantive

reaction_function.then: The ministry restates the ceiling rule and offers a phased schedule
reaction_function.because: It needs a fiscal justification on the record

beliefs_about.belief: Above the ceiling and likely to rise
Will revise the estimate rather than escalate, because escalation has failed before
Believes the ministry is blocking for institutional reasons rather than fiscal ones

falsifiers: A programme approved above the ceiling with ministry co-signature
A delay that continues after a revised estimate inside the ceiling is submitted
premises_missing: The ministry's internal cost review, which is not public
